measurement: Mean per-run sum of test-class wall-clock spans (first startTime to last endTime) in seconds; includes shared class setup. Dedicated-lane fixtures are excluded. Concurrent classes overlap, so this is test work, not job wall time. Unmeasured prefixes use one second per source file.

conformance.measurement: Mean per-run sum of wall-attributed seconds per test class: the class span (first startTime to last endTime) plus the idle time before its first test starts while no other class in the same TRX was running, which is where shared class fixtures run. Each TRX then sums to about its test wall time. Dedicated-lane fixtures are excluded. Unmeasured prefixes use one second per test class.
